title: DatePicker
description: Fiori date picker: a date field with lenient parsing, value states and a calendar value help.

usage.summary: Enter or select one localized Gregorian date.
useWhen: Let users choose a single date without keeping a calendar permanently visible.
Allow direct typing as well as selection from the calendar.
Set formatPattern, minDate and maxDate to show the expected format and enforce valid dates.

avoidWhen.when: Enter a start and end date as one interval.
Enter both a date and a time in one field.
Keep the calendar visible or select separate days.
Enter plain text without date or time parsing, or compose a custom picker with caller-owned value rules.
